saw_lines: Hotel managers rarely switch systems. They pick one, then judge it by how fast the front desk clears a busy check-in.
So the sale is won or lost on the page where a manager first sees the system working.
Your 59 Google creatives are 26 text, 12 image and 2 video, so the product rarely gets shown. Film three recordings of check-in and billing, opening on your £5 per room figure.
ads_1: Screen-recorded check-in and billing videos, each opening on the £5 per room figure
soc_1: Brand social strategy across YouTube, your only linked channel
